name: SoundCloud
description: Browse SoundCloud tracks, artists and playlists; play progressive files or finite HLS audio in memory; import only artist-authorized original downloads. HLS offline import is not supported.
sourceNotice: Requires your own authorized SoundCloud application client identity and service access. This adapter never scrapes web-player credentials or bypasses subscription, preview, region, encryption or artist download restrictions. Only artist-enabled original downloads may be imported into encrypted staging; HLS plays in memory but offline HLS remux/import and seeking are not supported. Current live API access has not been verified without an approved identity.
